patch_description: Two targeted changes. (1) Add a strict positive-min-area validation guard before returning: if the best configuration is degenerate (min area <= 0), retry at least one restart rather than silently returning a degenerate fallback — this eliminates the dominant silent-failure mode. (2) Add extra deterministic, symmetry-exploiting starting configurations (mirror-symmetric point sets are known to be near-optimal for the Heilbronn problem in equilateral triangles), giving the multi-start optimizer better basins to descend into. Both changes cost little runtime given the ample budget headroom.
